blocks.section: Warning Event / Error Codes generated during operations:
blocks.markdown:
| Error                                                              | Problem                                                                                  | Solution                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| E84: Invalid date Event log only                                   | Invalid date detected at start-up                                                        | Enter correct date and time in settings. For repeated events, download the up to date firmware from merrycheftechnical.com and load on to the oven.                                                                                      |
| E98: Incomplete cleaning Event log only                            | Cleaning sequence not completed by operator                                              | Complete cleaning process as instructed.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| E99: Air Filter Override Event log only (for display see solution) | Operator selected continue when filter was removed (filter microswitch was open circuit) | Check filter magnet, filter microswitch & connections Operator warning message = ' Air filter removed . Please replace the air filter to continue. (By selecting cancel and overriding the air filter monitoring this will be logged.) ' |

section_path.title: Warning Event / Error Codes generated during operations:

blocks.markdown:
| Error                                           | Problem                                                     | Solution                                                          |
|-------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| E81: Firmware updated Event log only            | UI or IO Firmware has been updated                          | Solution not required                                             |
| E82: menu updated Event log only                | Menu file has been updated                                  | Solution not required                                             |
| E86: Soft Power On Event log only               | Touch screen on switch used.                                | Solution not required if events correspond with normal operation. |
| E87: Completed Cleaning Sequence Event log only | Cleaning sequence completed.                                | Solution not required if events correspond with normal operation. |
| E100: Main Power On Event log only              | IO board supplied with 12V once mains power is switched on. | Solution not required if events correspond with normal operation. |
